scripts.dev:lan: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1 || echo 'unknown'); if [ "$IP" = "unknown" ]; then echo "Can't test on a different device: IP is unknown"; else echo "LAN test: http://${IP}:8888"; fi; netlify dev --command "python3 -m http.server 3999" --target-port 3999 --functions netlify/functions --functions-port 9999 --port 8888
scripts.dev:live: npm run dev:lan & cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8888
